SELECT IFNULL(kwd_stats.KWD_COUNT, 0) AS selection_count, round(IFNULL(kwd_stats.KWD_COUNT, 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(cate_stats.CATE_COUNT, 0), 1) AS selection_ratio, ifnull(total_kwd_stats.TOTAL_KWD_COUNT, 0) AS total_keyword_in_category FROM INTEREST_KEYWORD AS IK LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SK.KWD_NO, count(*) AS kwd_count FROM SELECTED_KEYWORD AS SK WHERE SK.KWD_NO = #{no} GROUP BY SK.KWD_NO ) AS kwd_stats ON IK.NO = kwd_stats.KWD_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT IK.CATE_NO, COUNT(*) AS cate_count FROM SELECTED_KEYWORD SK JOIN INTEREST_KEYWORD IK ON SK.KWD_NO = IK.NO WHERE IK.CATE_NO = (SELECT CATE_NO FROM INTEREST_KEYWORD WHERE NO = #{no}) GROUP BY IK.CATE_NO ) AS cate_stats ON IK.CATE_NO = cate_stats.CATE_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cate_no, count(*) AS total_kwd_count FROM INTEREST_KEYWORD WHERE cate_no = (SELECT cate_no FROM INTEREST_KEYWORD WHERE NO = #{no}) GROUP BY cate_no ) AS total_kwd_stats ON IK.CATE_NO = total_kwd_stats.CATE_NO WHERE IK.NO = #{no}
